assertions.predicate: After merge and deploy verify Worker release identity with worker-release-smoke.v1, restricted to --lane worker --phase post --only release-identity at the deployed merge SHA. Separately require python3 tools/prove-mail-needs-partner.py --production --natural --merged-sha <deployed-merge-sha> --other-call-wrapper <existing-second-partner-wrapper>. The dedicated CLI must parse mail-needs-partner.v1 from a natural pending proposal, retain its real ID, source reference, explicit priority reason and exact existing review command, corroborate pending status, version and source activity in list-email-proposals, and exclude that ID from a complete distinct-partner mailbox. The second mailbox must have no further page. Release smoke supplies ancillary release evidence only and cannot attest this mail observation.
assertions.expected_result: Require both registered release evidence and the dedicated CLI exit 0 with mail-needs-partner-proof.v1 state observed, count 1, pending=true, isolated=true, review_reference=true and the deployed merged release SHA. Missing natural records, a missing or same partner wrapper, incomplete second-mailbox coverage, failed auth, unavailable source, contract mismatch or wrong release returns insufficient_evidence and exit 78; remain landed-unproven. Never infer delivered or replied from pending or queued.
assertions.input_class: Registered observer reads Worker and app release identities only; safety budgets below apply to that observation. Separately authorized CLI uses existing authenticated local-actor wrappers with no caller-selected mailbox: one primary row, up to 50 distinct-mailbox rows, and at most twenty canonical pages of 50 rows. It makes at most 23 reads including release, uses ten-second call deadlines and a sixty-second wrapper budget, and retains only counts, IDs and sanitized predicates. No seeded production data or credential arguments.
